relationships.subject: remifentanil
relationships.evidence_quote: Proteomic analysis revealed that remifentanil upregulates PAK4 protein in spinal cord tissue two hours after the surgery.

relationships.subject: PAK4
relationships.evidence_quote: downregulation of PAK4 inhibits the increase in PAK4, p-p65, NLRP3 and Caspase-1 induced by LPS

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inhibitor
relationships.evidence_quote: Intrathecal injection of NLRP3 or PAK4 inhibitors mitigates remifentanil-induced hyperalgesia and associated changes.

key_findings: PAK4 acts upstream of NF-κB/NLRP3 in remifentanil-induced microglial inflammation and hyperalgesia.
